findings.summary: Reuse the existing data-engine-stubs.cpp factories in the generated warning-contract executable tests.
Share SceneNode vector component projection between direct property reads and retained handle aliases, preserving their component metadata.
Use the switch-narrowed CSG2 operation directly instead of searching the operation list and asserting a result.
Prefilter CSG source identifiers by spelling before checking resolved-symbol identity.
Emit try/catch directly when no finally block requires body capture and reordered native guard emission.
Consolidate numeric, vector and reference-struct conditional dispatch through the common sink while preserving static Value metadata and compiling the predicate once.

reviewExecution: Four independent agents inherited the parent model. Three initial angles ran concurrently and the fourth ran when a slot became available; all completed before fixes. All four angles reviewed subsequent optional getter, fresh-container indexing and numeric conditional corrections. The final conditional consolidation was then independently rechecked under all four angles, with no further findings. Follow-up reviews used available host slots, including sequential passes. All six findings were applied.
